request.prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural. One real photograph for a Spanish-speaking adult beginner learning English. Natural everyday photographic detail, real food, glass, ceramic and fabric texture, soft natural daylight and correct perspective; NOT an illustration, 3D render, cartoon, collage, cutout or app UI. Full-bleed 3:2 landscape; no frames, padding, blur bands, vignette, watermark or captions. A first-time learner must understand the picture instantly on a small phone screen. Do not imitate earlier course photos.

Keep the main subject of the photo whole inside the central 55 percent of the photo width, so a centered 4:5 crop keeps it whole; only expendable background reaches the left and right edges.

VEGETABLES. A plain wicker basket full of several different fresh vegetables clearly visible together: carrots, a head of broccoli, a zucchini, a red bell pepper, an onion and green beans. There is NO fruit in the basket on a plain light wooden table, photographed from a little above. The food is the only subject: it is sharp, large and in the middle of the photo. Nothing else is on the table: no cutlery, no glass, no napkin, no other food, no hands, no people. No letters, words, numbers, logos, labels or brand marks anywhere.

cost.basis: Reported usage at list prices checked 2026-09-24; before tax, not an invoice.
